summary: Frontend-only regression covering the four requested feature areas: (1) expanded/round-based games, (2) bilingual English+Spanish content, (3) level photos, (4) certificate rebrand from SENA to English Kids. All checks pass.

/map renders all 7 map-node-<id> cards with LEVEL_IMAGES thumbnails and bilingual titles (e.g. 'Alphabet · Alfabeto'); only level 1 is 'current', levels 2-7 have class 'locked' (6/6 locked).

PairMatchGame ROUND PROGRESSION (Alphabet, 26 pairs / perRound 6 / 5 rounds) — matched every pair via [data-testid=pair-left-alph-i]+[data-testid=pair-right-alph-i]. game-round counter advanced 1/5 → 2/5 → 3/5 → 4/5 → 5/5 automatically; game-progress reached 26/26. Backend /api/progress recorded level_id=1 score=26/26 stars=3 and unlocked_level=2.
Fast-completed levels 2..7 via POST /api/progress (all 200). cert-cta then appears on /map.

/certificate — certificate-page renders, cert-gate NOT shown. NO occurrence of 'SENA' anywhere in the page HTML (0 hits). 'English Kids' appears 6× including .cert-inst-name ('English Kids'), title, seal ('EnglishKids'), footer. Name 'Kid Tester', stars 21/21, date '22 de agosto de 2026'.

Colors game (level 3) — level page loads; 6 color-<Word> swatch testids visible per round (design shows options subset), consistent with 12-round configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx, Login.jsx, Register.jsx still reference SENA extensively. Task scope explicitly required removal only from certificate/map/navbar, and those are clean. If the user wants 'no SENA anywhere', these auth pages need rebranding too — flag for main agent confirmation.
PairMatchGame round advance is well-guarded: useEffect on matched size triggers loadRound(n+1) or saveProgress on final round via setTimeout(550ms) with cleanup — solid.

Register.jsx has password2 confirmation field but the AuthContext.register only requires password — good UX guard; tests must fill both fields when using UI (I bypassed by hitting /api/auth/register directly).
